CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS robot_model_performance_summary AS
WITH robot_metrics AS (
    -- Per-robot metrics
    SELECT 
        rd.modelseriesval,
        rd.botdetreg,

    ROUND(AVG(robot_ape)::numeric, 2) AS avg_error,
    ROUND(AVG(robot_atcs)::numeric, 2) AS avg_speed,
    ROUND(AVG(robot_toh)::numeric, 2) AS avg_duration
FROM robot_metrics
GROUP BY modelseriesval;
